facts.claim: Nicola Salvi’s design was selected for Trevi Fountain; Oceanus is the central figure.
facts.excerpt: e various projects presented, that of the architect Nicola Salvi was chosen. Leaning against Palazzo Poli, the fountain is divided into a wide basin with a large cliff enlivened by the sculptural representation of numerous plants and the spectacular flow of water. In the center dominates the statue of god Ocean driving the shell-shaped chariot, pulled by the angry horse and the placid horse, both held back by two tritons.
